youtube.title: George Washington's teeth weren't wood. The truth is worse 🦛 #shorts
youtube.caption:
George Washington never had wooden teeth. 🦷

His dentist knows what they were really made of... and Washington cannot tell a lie.

Team Wood or Team Hippo? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: by his 1789 inauguration Washington had one real tooth left. His dentures, several made by dentist John Greenwood, used hippopotamus ivory, human teeth, brass and gold springs, but never wood.

#georgewashington #americanhistory #historicalmyths #weirdhistory #foundingfathers #historymemes #shorts
